name: Ranhartalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ranhartalm in Ellmau – a cozy mountain hut in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**!**

Nestled at **1,500 meters** above sea level, this traditional **Tiroler Alm** offers breathtaking views of the **Hochfeiler** and **Ahornspitze** peaks. Enjoy authentic **Tiroler cuisine**, including hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain milk products.

Whether you're hiking, skiing, or simply relaxing with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** and a cup of **Kaffee**, Ranhartalm is the perfect retreat. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, it’s an ideal escape into nature.

**Come and experience the warmth of the Alps!** 🏔️✨
